title: Pivot Monthly Revenue into Jan–Dec Columns
description:
Pivot a row-per-month revenue table into a wide format with one column per calendar month (Jan through Dec).

**Table: monthly_sales** — `year`, `month_num`, `revenue`

Output columns: `year`, `Jan`, `Feb`, `Mar`, `Apr`, `May`, `Jun`, `Jul`, `Aug`, `Sep`, `Oct`, `Nov`, `Dec`. Order by `year`.
solution_sql: SELECT year, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 1 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Jan, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 2 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Feb, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 3 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Mar, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 4 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Apr, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 5 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS May, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 6 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Jun, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 7 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Jul, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 8 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Aug, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 9 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Sep, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 10 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Oct, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 11 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Nov, SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = 12 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS Dec FROM monthly_sales GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

test_cases.description: 24 monthly rows (12 per year × 2 years) pivoted into 2 wide rows, one per year

hints: Write one SUM(CASE WHEN month_num = N THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) expression for each of the 12 months.
GROUP BY year collapses all 12 monthly rows per year into a single wide row; ELSE 0 avoids NULL in the output.
explanation: This is the standard conditional aggregation pivot pattern applied across all 12 months. For each column the CASE expression acts as a filter — only the matching month's revenue is summed; all other months contribute 0. GROUP BY year collapses 12 rows into 1 row per year. 2025 row: Jan=75000, …, Dec=148000. 2026 row: Jan=80000, …, Dec=170000. Total: 2 output rows.
